instruction: Automatically detect and remove black bars from videos based on content analysis.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC cannot automatically analyze video content to detect and dynamically remove black bars. While VLC has crop filters, automatic content-based detection and removal is not supported.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - VLC does not support automatic content-based black bar detection
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the semantically correct choice for impossible tasks
Metadata explanation accurately describes why this task cannot be completed (VLC has manual crop filters but no automatic content analysis)
No verification logic is needed since the task cannot be performed as described
